spec.rawSql:
WITH runs AS (
  SELECT *,
    lag(total)       OVER w AS previous_total,
    lag(failed)      OVER w AS previous_failed,
    lag(passed)      OVER w AS previous_passed,
    lag(duration_ms) OVER w AS previous_duration_ms
  FROM test_runs
  WHERE finished_at IS NOT NULL
    AND environment IN (${Environment:sqlstring})
  WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY environment ORDER BY finished_at, id)
), metrics AS (
  SELECT
    total, passed, failed, duration_ms,
    round(100.0 * passed / nullif(total, 0), 1) AS pass_rate,
    total - previous_total AS total_change,
    failed - previous_failed AS failed_change,
    round(100.0 * passed / nullif(total, 0)
      - 100.0 * previous_passed / nullif(previous_total, 0), 1) AS pass_rate_change_pp,
    duration_ms - previous_duration_ms AS duration_change_ms
  FROM runs
  WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at)
  ORDER BY finished_at DESC, id DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT *,
  to_char(total, 'FM999,999,999') AS total_display,
  to_char(passed, 'FM999,999,999') AS passed_display,
  to_char(failed, 'FM999,999,999') AS failed_display,
  pass_rate::text || '%' AS pass_rate_display,
  CASE WHEN total_change IS NULL THEN '—'
       WHEN total_change > 0 THEN '↑ +' || total_change::text
       WHEN total_change < 0 THEN '↓ ' || total_change::text
       ELSE '– 0' END AS total_change_display,
  CASE WHEN failed_change IS NULL THEN '—'
       WHEN failed_change > 0 THEN '↑ +' || failed_change::text
       WHEN failed_change < 0 THEN '↓ ' || failed_change::text
       ELSE '– 0' END AS failed_change_display,
  CASE WHEN pass_rate_change_pp IS NULL THEN '—'
       WHEN pass_rate_change_pp > 0 THEN '↑ +' || pass_rate_change_pp::text || ' pp'
       WHEN pass_rate_change_pp < 0 THEN '↓ ' || pass_rate_change_pp::text || ' pp'
       ELSE '– 0.0 pp' END AS pass_rate_change_display,
  CASE WHEN duration_change_ms IS NULL THEN '—'
       ELSE (CASE WHEN duration_change_ms > 0 THEN '↑ '
                  WHEN duration_change_ms < 0 THEN '↓ '
                  ELSE '– ' END)
         || (abs(duration_change_ms) / 60000)::text || 'm '
         || lpad(((abs(duration_change_ms) / 1000) % 60)::text, 2, '0') || 's'
  END AS duration_change_display,
  (duration_ms / 60000)::text || 'm '
    || lpad(((duration_ms / 1000) % 60)::text, 2, '0') || 's'
    AS duration_display
FROM metrics;

spec.title: PASS RATE TREND
spec.description: Pass rate for each run over the last 30 days. Uses the selected Environment and also includes the run containing Result ID, even if that run has no environment label.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  started_at AS time,
  CASE
    WHEN total = 0 THEN 0.0
    ELSE 100.0 * CAST(passed AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / total
  END AS "Pass rate"
FROM test_runs
WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at)
  AND environment IN (${Environment:sqlstring})
ORDER BY 1;

spec.title: FAILURES BY MODULE
spec.description: Final unexpected outcomes by first suite name, counted once per test, run, and browser.

spec.rawSql:
WITH final_results AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (r.run_id, r.project, r.file, r.line, r.title)
    r.title, r.file, r.outcome
  FROM test_results AS r
  JOIN test_runs AS run ON run.id = r.run_id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(run.started_at)
    AND run.environment IN (${Environment:sqlstring})
  ORDER BY r.run_id, r.project, r.file, r.line, r.title, r.retry DESC, r.id DESC
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN strpos(title, ' › ') > 0 THEN split_part(title, ' › ', 1)
    ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(file, ''), 'Uncategorized')
  END AS module,
  COUNT(*)::double precision AS failures
FROM final_results
WHERE outcome = 'unexpected'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY failures DESC, module

spec.title: TEST DURATION TREND
spec.description: Each point shows the average test run duration for a UTC day over the last 30 days, filtered by the selected environment. Higher values mean runs took longer.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeGroupAlias(started_at, '1d'),
  AVG(duration_ms)::double precision AS "Average run duration"
FROM test_runs
WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at)
  AND environment IN (${Environment:sqlstring})
  AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  r.id AS "Run ID",
  r.started_at AS "Run time",
  COALESCE(INITCAP(r.environment), 'Unknown') AS "Env",
  'All' AS "Module",
  COALESCE(r.passed, 0) AS "Pass",
  COALESCE(r.failed, 0) AS "Fail",
  CASE
    WHEN r.duration_ms IS NULL THEN '—'
    ELSE (r.duration_ms / 60000)::text || 'm '
      || LPAD(((r.duration_ms / 1000) % 60)::text, 2, '0') || 's'
  END AS "Duration"
FROM test_runs r
WHERE $__timeFilter(r.started_at)
  AND r.environment IN (${Environment:sqlstring})
ORDER BY r.started_at DESC, r.id DESC;

SELECT
  title,
  round(avg(duration_ms)) AS avg_ms
FROM test_results
WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at)
GROUP BY title
ORDER BY avg_ms DESC
LIMIT 10
